gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Ancient and sparse, like brush dabs set far apart. Nordic delivers that powerful, single-weight punch, while Noto Sans Glagolitic keeps its round letters clear and sturdy at small sizes.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha keeps its bowls open, a clear contrast to Nordic's cramped, closed letters. Noto Sans Grantha reads smoothly down a page of text, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati opens its curves wide, ending strokes before they turn inward. Nordic is best at dowel-straight stems and bent arcs, while the body font is best at running text with large openings.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-jp: Sweeping curves and a very high x-height give this body text a modern, open feel. Noto Sans JP carries the long reading, while Nordic, a single constant line tracing each letter, supplies the powerful, ancient punch.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has generous, chisel-notch openings and small letters that stand almost capital-sized. Nordic, in turn, is best at powerful, ancient headings, while the body font is best at open, readable text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Nordic sets ancient, brush-dab spacing and a cramped opening in one monoweight stroke. Noto Sans Limbu is the opposite in its job, gaping curves built for reading, where Nordic is built to make a powerful statement.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: A single-weight outline feel runs through every Nordic letter. Noto Sans Mahajani is its opposite, with a wide, funnel-like throat in the e and lowercase standing proud of the capitals.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Powerful and ancient up top, Nordic hands off to Noto Sans Malayalam, whose middle zone dominates each line. And that open s keeps the text moving, so the closed, cramped heading letters stand out against it.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Nordic looks like letters bent from a single wire, powerful and ancient, spaced like brush dabs placed far apart. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads smoothly, its gaping c open at any size.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-mende-kik: Nordic traces each letter without any calligraphic shading, a monoweight stroke with a powerful, ancient feel. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui adds visible daylight through every curve, so text beneath the heading stays modern and clean.
